description: Make Reading Advantage the first company-operations licensing consumer by importing expired history and centrally provisioning demos, school trials, and new or renewed subscriptions into Reading's local license model.
deviation_notes: Reading remains locally authoritative at runtime during the pilot. Existing expired licenses are historical imports only and are never automatically reactivated.

sprint.goal: Prove a safe Reading-first licensing workflow from CRM customer or trial through central subscription management to product-local school and license enforcement.
